calls.summary: Create a draft (gets the DRAFT label). Safer default than sending.

params.notes: Body is a Draft resource whose message.raw is a base64url-encoded RFC 2822 email.

config.generic:
RAW=$(printf 'To: you@example.com\r\nSubject: Test draft\r\n\r\nHello' | base64 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=\n')
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"message\":{\"raw\":\"$RAW\"}}" \
  "https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/drafts"

smoke.notes: Creates a real draft. Run only against a test mailbox.

calls.body: The raw-message format (base64url RFC 2822) comes from the Message schema's raw field in the discovery doc.

calls.summary: Post a message to a channel, DM or thread.

params.notes: Pass the token as a Bearer header. markdown_text max 12,000 chars; keep text under 4,000. Use thread_ts to reply in a thread.

auth.notes: Same scope for bot and user tokens. Bots need chat:write.public to post in public channels they haven't joined. Bots can't post into a DM between two users.

config.generic:
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" \
  -d '{"channel":"C0123456789","text":"Hello from the registry"}'

rate_limit.notes: Generally about 1 message per second per channel.

errors.meaning: Cannot post user messages to a channel they are not in.
errors.fix: Invite the bot to the channel, or add chat:write.public for public channels.

errors.meaning: Value passed for channel was invalid.
errors.fix: Use the channel ID (C..., G..., D...), not the name.

errors.meaning: The token is not granted the scope this call needs.
errors.fix: Add chat:write to the app and reinstall it to the workspace.

smoke.notes: Posts a real message. Use a private test channel the bot is in.

calls.summary: Edit a message the same token posted.

params.notes: Only messages posted by the same authenticated user or bot can be updated. Ephemeral messages can't be updated.

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" \
  -d '{"channel":"C0123456789","ts":"1700000000.000100","text":"Edited"}'

errors.meaning: The authenticated user doesn't have permission to update this message.
errors.fix: Update with the same token that posted it.

errors.meaning: No message exists with that timestamp.
